planetFunctions.sun: The Sun governs how you take up space, express who you are, and where you shine.
planetFunctions.moon: The Moon governs how you feel, what comforts you, and how you recover.
planetFunctions.mercury: Mercury governs how you think, speak, listen, and decide.
planetFunctions.venus: Venus governs affection, pleasure, and how you recognize when someone values you.
planetFunctions.mars: Mars governs how you go after what you want, stand up for yourself, and handle conflict.
planetFunctions.jupiter: Jupiter governs how you take risks, trust possibility, and grow.
planetFunctions.saturn: Saturn governs responsibility, commitment, work, and consequences.
planetFunctions.uranus: Uranus governs rebellion, innovation, and change.
planetFunctions.neptune: Neptune governs imagination, spirituality, and intuition.
planetFunctions.pluto: Pluto governs transformation, power, and rebirth.

signMechanics.aries: Aries is cardinal fire, ruled by Mars: The Warrior. The spark of consciousness and identity, the ram that leads with its head. It's the sign that starts things: raw new energy that wants to break with the past and begin again.
signMechanics.taurus: Taurus is fixed earth, ruled by Venus: The Sensualist. Body awareness, self-worth, foundation, and values, the bull that will not be rushed. It's the sign that grows things: where new energy takes root and becomes something solid you can live on.
signMechanics.gemini: Gemini is mutable air, ruled by Mercury: The Messenger. The sign of communication and connection, the twins who see both sides. It's the sign that reaches outward: more contacts, more ideas, more ways of being connected to everything.
signMechanics.cancer: Cancer is cardinal water, ruled by the Moon: The Nurturer. The sign of memory, emotion, and emotional protection, the crab whose hard shell guards the soft center. It's the sign that draws the line around what's yours: the home, the family, the person you become inside them.
signMechanics.leo: Leo is fixed fire, ruled by the Sun: The King, The Queen, The Creator. The season to celebrate life and express love, the lion at ease in the open. It's the sign that makes a self worth showing: creative power released outward, stamped with your name, and meant to be seen.
signMechanics.virgo: Virgo is mutable earth, ruled by Mercury: The Healer. Self-reflection and self-improvement, the harvester who keeps what's worth keeping. It's the sign that stops and asks why: refining raw experience into skill, technique, and usable meaning.
signMechanics.libra: Libra is cardinal air, ruled by Venus: The Diplomat. The sign of relating, socializing, and connecting, the scales that never stop weighing. It's the sign that hands the self to something bigger: relationship, culture, and the art of living well with other people.
signMechanics.scorpio: Scorpio is fixed water, ruled by Mars in the ancient system and Pluto in the modern: The Alchemist. Deep commitments made on the emotional, sexual, and financial level, the scorpion that guards what matters. It's the sign that goes to the bottom of what binds people: where giving yourself over becomes a kind of power.
signMechanics.sagittarius: Sagittarius is mutable fire, ruled by Jupiter: The Philosopher. The sign of belief, freedom, and the far horizon, the archer aiming past what it can see. It's the sign that turns experience into meaning: the beliefs you live by and the maps you trust.
signMechanics.capricorn: Capricorn is cardinal earth, ruled by Saturn: The Ruler. The sign of ambition, endurance, and the long climb, the sea-goat built for the depths and the peaks. It's the sign that makes the vision real: structure, staying power, the thing still standing years later.
signMechanics.aquarius: Aquarius is fixed air, ruled by Saturn in the ancient system and Uranus in the modern: The Innovator, The Maverick. The shift from personal ambition to the benefit of the collective, the water-bearer pouring for everyone. It's the sign that frees what got built: taking what works and opening it up for everyone.
signMechanics.pisces: Pisces is mutable water, ruled by Jupiter in the ancient system and Neptune in the modern: The Mystic. The cosmic womb that unites us all, the two fish swimming between worlds. It's the sign that closes the cycle: it gathers what's been lived, turns it into compassion, and lets the rest go.

do: express where you are now, not where you were
find inspiration everywhere you go
take up the space that's yours in your own story
dont: dim your fire to make someone else's candle look brighter
burn to prove you're on fire
keep proving yourself to people who only clap when you're quiet

do: check in with yourself before you check on everyone else
pick one small habit that supports your well-being and stick with it for a week
put the weight down, even if no one else is ready to pick it up
dont: stay on duty holding everything together
carry what was never yours to carry
make lasting decisions from a passing mood

do: speak from clarity, not control
give people the space to speak; they'll tell you everything you need to know
script the hard conversation and rehearse it if you have to
dont: talk over the reveal
negotiate your truth to stay connected
dilute what you mean to keep others comfortable

do: step back far enough to see the pattern before the next step
check whether the commitment still fits who you are now
slow down long enough to see if their actions match their words
dont: keep moving inside the momentum of a decision you've outgrown
confuse slowing down with falling behind
sign what you wouldn't choose today

do: appreciate what you already have
let yourself enjoy it
choose connections where your voice is respected
dont: touch what's become toxic
confuse love with duty
mistake what's familiar for what's good for you

do: ask whether you truly want it, not just whether you can have it
let the lessons of the past months shape your next steps
admit you've outgrown the version of you who made the choice
dont: chase closure from people who never give it
make it official mid-retrograde
reopen what closed for good reason

do: protect the momentum you've built and your capacity for the next move
act when the timing actually works in your favor
burn off the tension with a run or a hard workout
dont: split your focus
fight out of habit
push past your limits without noticing

do: step back far enough to see whether you're fighting for something or just fighting out of habit
rest; there's a difference between resilience and never letting yourself rest
put it all down and walk away for the night
dont: reignite a fight because it's familiar
prove strength by never resting
force the timing when it isn't yours

do: find inspiration everywhere you go
protect your position so you can try again until it sticks
remember the day you plant the seed is not the day you eat the fruit
dont: confuse momentum with meaning
promise past your capacity
mistake more for better

do: check the date on old beliefs; some have expired
clean up the mess before you build something new on top of it
review whether the plan still serves who you are now
dont: double down out of pride
build on top of what needs clearing first
mistake motion for growth

do: hold your energy until it can create the most impact
keep a Plan B without betraying Plan A
create stability that supports who you are now, not who you had to be
dont: pay for it with your peace; that price is too high
be available for every crisis
prove your worth by holding everything together for everyone

do: renegotiate the outdated agreements that only look like discipline
admit you've outgrown the version of you who made the commitment
check which rules were ever actually yours
dont: treat the pause as falling behind
honor a commitment that's no longer in service to who you are
call self-punishment discipline

do: make waves; you can't make them keeping your feet dry
let your difference be the blueprint for something they've never seen
say the honest version
dont: fold yourself into origami so people can fit you in their pocket
blend to belong
wait for permission to change

do: keep the change that freed you
review what the shake-up was actually for
test the next change quietly before you announce it
dont: go back just because it's familiar
reverse course out of fear
shock people just to feel something move

do: trust your intuition, then verify with your eyes
give yourself space that restores you; that isn't selfish
honor what's actually happening in your life
dont: romanticize something that can't hold you
avoid the deeper truths trying to emerge
rescue what only drains you

do: let the illusions fall
tend to what's real
write down what surfaces; it develops into practical intel
dont: rebuild the fantasy mid-collapse
numb what's finally clear
chase the feeling of fate over the facts

do: name the pattern; to break it, you must first name it
sort what's yours to hold from what was never yours to carry
let what ends make space for what heals
dont: live around the truth instead of through it
control everything to feel secure
carry what doesn't belong to you

do: trace where the pattern began
release what you're ready to shed
give it ceremony, give it rest
dont: rush the unraveling
dig up what's still composting
prosecute old versions of yourself
